name: native-user-only

messages.content: What is the capital of France?

name: native-root-system-sp
notes: a root first message: the system sp carries its text with the Current date and Current location lines before the thinking instructions; the developer sp stays the default

name: native-system-as-developer-sp
notes: a system first message maps to the developer sp (the lower priority); the system sp is the default text

name: native-root-then-developer
notes: root then developer as the first two messages: both special prompts filled

name: native-model-identity-kwarg

chat_template_kwargs.model_identity: You are Max, a careful assistant.

notes: the model_identity kwarg replaces the default developer sp text when no developer message is given

name: native-effort-high
notes: reasoning_effort: the effort tag after the model_id line in the system sp

name: native-effort-alias-low
notes: the effort kwarg is the template's second name for the same tag

name: native-effort-max
notes: the template renders any effort word it is given; the contract's levels are the gateway's to map

name: native-thinking-switch-ignored
notes: the template has no thinking switch: this renders the same text as the user-only case (the thinking mode line says adaptive either way)

name: native-tools-declared

name: native-call-and-result-history

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the current weather for a city

notes: a call in the history as the XML invoke block after the think prefix, then one tool turn with the result in a response element

name: native-parallel-calls-two-results

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the current weather for a city

notes: two invokes in one tool_call block; the two results share one tool header and close with one end token

name: native-nested-arguments-history
notes: nested arguments: an object expands to child elements, an array to item elements, a boolean prints as JSON, a null field is omitted; content before the call block

name: native-assistant-with-reasoning
notes: an assistant history turn with reasoning_content: the think block before the answer (all-turn visible)

name: native-assistant-inline-think-split
notes: the same turn written inline in content: the template splits it at the think end tag and renders the block

name: native-assistant-no-reasoning
notes: an assistant history turn without reasoning: the think end tag as a prefix before the text

name: native-mid-conversation-developer

messages.content: From here on, answer in French.

notes: a developer message after the first turn keeps its place as a developer turn

name: native-multimodal-user-parts
notes: content parts in a user turn: text as text, an image part as the image token, a video part as the video token, in order

name: native-multimodal-tool-result

function.name: get_weather

notes: a tool result with parts: the text part and the image token inside the response element

name: native-continue-final-message
notes: continuing a final assistant text: the turn left open without its end token

name: native-tool-result-without-call

function.name: get_weather
